text: Simple illustration of a stunning, high-contrast cinematic portrait of a formidable Dark Fantasy Warrior/Knight. He wears heavy, ornate black and dark steel plate armor, adorned with gothic trim and dark leather straps. He is crowned with a menacing, spiked helm. The warrior holds a curved, ritualistic sword and a massive, elaborate shield featuring a striking central skull motif. The lighting is dramatic, deep chiaroscuro, with a single warm, ethereal light source illuminating him from the side, making the metallic surfaces gleam richly. He is standing within a vast, dimly lit stone archway/cathedral hall. The overall atmosphere is heavy, melancholic, and epic. Extreme detail, photorealistic, digital painting by Brom and Frank Frazetta, deep volumetric lighting.
